.float-right {float: right;}
.float-left {float: left;}
.text-center {text-align: center;}
.row-medium {margin-left: -10px;margin-right: -10px;display: block;}
.row-medium [class*=" col-"], .row-medium [class^=col-] {padding-left: 10px;padding-right: 10px;}
.row-gallery {margin-left: -2px;margin-right: -2px;}
.row-gallery [class*=" col-"], .row-gallery [class^=col-] {padding-left: 1px;padding-right: 1px;padding-top: 1px;padding-bottom: 1px;}
.mobile-header .header-cell {display: table-cell;width: 20%;vertical-align: middle;}
.text-right {text-align: right;}
.text-left {text-align: left;}
.blog-feeds {
display: none;
}
/* ====================
1:FontFamily
* ==================== */
@font-face{font-family:Neo;font-style:normal;font-weight:normal;src:url("data:font/woff;base64,") format("woff")}
/* ====================
2:Body
* ==================== */
body{background:#ffffff;direction:rtl;font:14px tahoma,sans-serif;font-weight:500;position:relative;margin:0;padding:0}
/* ====================
3:Error 404
* ==================== */
#error-not-found{background:#ffffff;position:fixed;top:0;right:0;bottom:0;left:0;z-index:999999;display:table;width:100%;height:100%}
div#error-not-found h1{font-size:150px;color:#8bc34a;font-family:arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:20px}
div#error-not-found h1 i{font-size:100px;color:#555555}
div#error-not-found p{font-family:Neo;font-size:30px;color:#555555}
div#error-not-found a{font-size:20px;font-family:Neo;color:#8bc34a}
div#error-not-found a:hover{color:#8bc34a}
div#error-not-found center{display:table-cell;vertical-align:middle}
/* ====================
4:Content Tamplate
* ==================== */
div#header-wrapper{background-color:#555555;margin-top:-20px}
#content-wrapper{background:#ffffff;overflow:hidden}
#main-wrapper{position:relative;margin:0;background:#ffffff}
#sidebar-wrapper{margin:30px 0 0}
/* ====================
5:TopNav
* ==================== */
.menutop{clear:both;padding:0;z-index:9999999;background:#333333}
#menu-top ul li{float:right;padding:0;position:relative;margin:4px 0 0;transition:.6s}
div#menu-top .widget{overflow:initial!important;margin:0}
div#menu-top{margin:0}
#menu-top ul li a{display:block;line-height:36px;transition:.6s;padding:0 12px;color:#7f8c8d;margin:0;font-size:14px;word-wrap:normal!important;overflow-wrap:normal!important;word-break:normal!important}
.selectnav{display:none}
#menu-top ul li a:hover{color:#ffffff!important;text-decoration:underline}
/* ====================
6:TopSocial
* ==================== */
div#top-social{margin:0!important}
.socl .widget{margin:0}
.socl ul li{overflow:hidden;float:left}
.socl a{display:block;width:30px;text-align:center;height:32px;color:#7f8c8d;line-height:32px;margin-right:5px;border-radius:7px;margin-top:6px}
.socl a:hover{color:#ffffff}
.socl a:before{font-family:FontAwesome;font-style:normal;font-weight:400;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;-moz-osx-font-smoothing:grayscale;text-align:center;font-size:16px}
.socl a:before{transition:all .6s}
.socl .facebook:before{content:"\f09a"!important}
.socl .twitter:before{content:"\f099"!important}
.socl .gplus:before{content:"\f0d5"!important}
.socl .rss:before{content:"\f09e"!important}
.socl .youtube:before{content:"\f167"!important}
.socl .skype:before{content:"\f17e"!important}
.socl .instagram:before{content:"\f16d"!important}
/* ====================
7:Logo & Ads
* ==================== */
div#logoads{overflow:hidden;padding:57px 0 0;display:inline}
div#logoads img{padding:10px;width:200px;height:200px}
#logoo{font-size:14px;font-family:Neo;color:#2f323b;font-weight:normal;text-align:right;margin:0 auto;box-sizing:border-box;background:#555555}
#logoo .titlewrapper h1{padding:11px;margin-bottom:25px}
#logoo .titlewrapper h1{font-family:Neo;color:#ffffff;font-weight:normal;font-size:30px}
#logoo .titlewrapper h1 a{font-family:Neo;color:#ffffff;font-weight:normal;font-size:30px}}
#logoo img{width:100%;height:150px;padding:0}
/* ====================
8:NavBar
* ==================== */
.menu-container{height:58px;clear:both;padding:0!important;padding:10px;z-index:9999999;border-top:0 solid transparent;border-bottom:2px solid #8bc34a;background:#333333}
#menu ul li{float:right;padding:0;position:relative;margin:0;transition:.6s}
div#menu .widget{overflow:initial!important;margin:0}
div#menu{margin:0}
#menu ul li a{display:block;line-height:50px;transition:.6s;padding:3px 12px;color:#7f8c8d;font-family:Neo;font-size:16px;word-wrap:normal!important;overflow-wrap:normal!important;word-break:normal!important}
#menu ul li:first-child a{background:#8bc34a;color:#ffffff}
#menu ul li:first-child:hover a{color:#ffffff}
#menu ul li a.has-sub{line-height:49px}
#menu ul li a.has-sub:after,#menu .m-mega-menu > a:after{content:"\f107";font-family:Fontawesome;position:relative;right:5px;top:2px}
#menu ul li:hover a{background:#8bc34a;color:#ffffff}
#sub-menu li:first-child a{background:#ffffff!important;color:#333333}
#sub-menu,#menu ul li.m-mega-menu .multi-post{position:absolute!important;top:56px;z-index:99999;width:250px!important;background:#ffffff;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;-webkit-box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba( 0,0,0,0.1 );-moz-box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba( 0,0,0,0.1 );box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba( 0,0,0,0.1 );-moz-transform:scaleY(0);-webkit-transform:scaleY(0);-o-transform:scaleY(0);-ms-transform:scaleY(0);transform:scaleY(0);-webkit-transform-origin:0 0;-moz-transform-origin:0 0;-o-transform-origin:0 0;-ms-transform-origin:0 0;transform-origin:0 0;transition:.3s;border:0}
#menu ul li.m-mega-menu .multi-post{width:100%!important}
#sub-menu li{float:none!important}
#sub-menu li a{line-height:45px!important;font-size:14px!important;transition:.6s;color:#333333!important;border-bottom:0!important;background:none!important;margin-left:0!important}
#sub-menu li a:before{content:"\f060";font-family:Fontawesome;padding-left:5px;font-size:10px}
#sub-menu li:first-child:hover{color:#ffffff!important}
#sub-menu li a:hover{color:#8bc34a!important}
.selectnav{display:none}
#menu ul li:hover #sub-menu,#menu ul li.m-mega-menu:hover .multi-post{opacity:1;visibility:visible;-moz-transform:scaleY(1);-webkit-transform:scaleY(1);-o-transform:scaleY(1);-ms-transform:scaleY(1);transform:scaleY(1);}
#menu ul li.m-mega-menu .multi-post{right:0;z-index:99999999;position:absolute;width:100%;max-width:100%;background:#ffffff;border:1px solid #eee;border-top:0 solid #eee;padding:7px!important;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;-moz-transform:scaleY(0);-webkit-transform:scaleY(0);-o-transform:scaleY(0);-ms-transform:scaleY(0);transform:scaleY(0);-webkit-transform-origin:0 0;-moz-transform-origin:0 0;-o-transform-origin:0 0;-ms-transform-origin:0 0;transform-origin:0 0;transition:.3s;height:auto!important}
.post-thumbnail{width:100%;height:175px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.post-thumbnail a{display:block;width:100%;height:100%}
.multi-post,li.m-mega-menu{position:static!important}
#menu .m-mega-menu .multi-post div.mulpost{display:block;overflow:hidden;width:25%;float:right;padding:6px}
#menu .m-mega-menu .multi-post div.mulpost .label-content{margin:0;width:100%}
#menu .m-mega-menu .multi-post div.mulpost .label-content .category{display:none!important}
#menu .m-mega-menu .multi-post div.mulpost .label-content .post-com{display:none}
#menu .m-mega-menu .multi-post div.mulpost .label-content .mpost-title a{color:#8bc34a;font-size:14px;background:#ffffff;padding:3px;margin:5px auto;transition:.6s;line-height:22px!important}
#menu .m-mega-menu .multi-post div.mulpost .label-content .mpost-title a:hover{text-decoration:underline}
#menu .m-mega-menu .multi-post div.mulpost .label-content .pinfo .mtime,#menu .m-mega-menu .multi-post div.mulpost .label-content .pinfo .post-author{font-family:Neo,tahoma;text-transform:capitalize;font-size:11px;color:#7f8c8d;text-align:center;margin-left:6px;padding-right:4px;margin-top:7px;opacity:.8}
#menu .m-mega-menu .multi-post div.mulpost .label-content .pinfo .post-author:after{content:"\f007";font-family:fontawesome;margin-left:5px}
#menu .m-mega-menu .multi-post div.mulpost .label-content .pinfo .mtime:after{content:"\f017";font-family:fontawesome;margin-left:5px}
#menu .m-mega-menu .multi-post div.mulpost .post-thumbnail a{transition:.6s}
#menu .m-mega-menu .multi-post div.mulpost:hover .post-thumbnail a{transform:scale(1.3)}
.search{background:rgba(238,238,238,0.8);position:fixed;z-index:999999999;width:100%;height:100%;text-align:center;transition:.6s;top:0;transform:scale(0);opacity:0}
input#in{transition:0.6s;font-family:'Neo';height:100px;color:#8bc34a;position:absolute;border-top:0;border-right:0;border-left:0;font-size:70px;border:none;top:50%;background:transparent;right:50%;margin-right:-250px;margin-top:-65px;width:500px;text-align:center}
div#sb{overflow:hidden;padding:3px;text-align:left}
span.sb,span.sc{cursor:pointer}
span.sc i{position:absolute;right:0;padding:13px;font-size:35px!important}
span.sb i{font-size:23px;color:#8bc34a;line-height:36px}
span.sc i{font-size:23px;color:#8bc34a}
span.sb i:hover{color:#7f8c8d}
span.sc i:hover{color:#7f8c8d}
.search.actived{transform:scale(1);opacity:1}
/* ====================
9:Slider
* ==================== */
.carousell{margin-top:5px;padding:0 2.5px;margin-bottom:5px}
.carousell .section{margin:0!important}
.ocraousel .mulpost{position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.ocraousel .multi-post{position:relative}
.ocraousel .mulpost .label-content a.category{padding:8px 11px;background:#8bc34a;color:#ffffff;font-family:Neo;font-size:14px;display:inline-block;z-index:1;border-radius:2px;font-weight:500;line-height:24px}
.ocraousel .label-content{position:absolute;bottom:0;height:300px;padding:15px;text-align:center;color:#ffffff;font-family:tahoma,sans-serif;font-size:26px;width:100%}
.ocraousel .mpost-title a{color:#ffffff;font-family:Neo;font-size:17px;display:block;font-weight:500;padding-right:5px;margin:15px auto 5px;line-height:24px}
.ocraousel .mpost-title a:hover{color:#8bc34a;text-decoration:underline}
.pinfo{font-weight:100}
.ocraousel .mulpost .pinfo li{text-transform:capitalize;font-size:11px;color:#ddd;display:inline-block;margin-left:6px;font-family:Neo,tahoma;padding-right:4px;margin-top:7px;font-weight:500;line-height:24px}
h3.mpost-title a{line-height:25px}
.ocraousel .mulpost .mtime{margin-left:15px}
.ocraousel .mulpost .pinfo li:before{font-family:fontawesome;display:inline-block;margin-left:5px}
.ocraousel .mulpost .post-author:before{content:"\f007"}
.ocraousel .mulpost .mtime:before{content:"\f017"}
.ocraousel .owl-controls{position:absolute;top:275px;width:100%}
.ocraousel .owl-prev{position:absolute;bottom:0;right:0}
.ocraousel .owl-next{position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0}
.ocraousel .owl-next,.ocraousel .owl-prev{padding:13px!important;font-size:18px!important;border-radius:0!important;background:#8bc34a!important}
.ocraousel .owl-next:hover,.ocraousel .owl-prev:hover{background:#ffffff!important;color:#8bc34a!important}
.ocraousel .owl-dots{display:none!important}
div#carousill{margin-top:30px!important}
/* ====================
10:Last post 1
* ==================== */
.lp1 .multi-post .mulpost{margin-bottom:15px;border-right:3px solid #ffffff;border-left:3px solid #ffffff;padding:0}
.lp1 .multi-post .category,.lp1 .multi-post .post-com,.lp1 .multi-post .post-author{display:none}
.lp1 .multi-post .mpost-title{padding:10px;background:#f8f8f8}
.lp1 .multi-post .mpost-title a{line-height:24px;color:#333333;font-family:neo;font-weight:500;font-size:16px}
.lp1 .multi-post .pinfo .mtime{position:absolute;top:0;margin:5px;padding:5px;background:#8bc34a;color:white;font-size:11px;font-family:neo}
#lp11 h2.title{color:#333333;font:normal 800 17px neo;line-height:25px;margin-bottom:15px;width:100%;background:#f8f8f8;padding:15px}
/* ====================
11:Last post 2
* ==================== */
div#lp22,div#lp33{margin:15px 0 0 0}
.lp2 .multi-post .mulpost:first-child{float:right;width:50%;margin-left:10px}
.lp2 .multi-post .mulpost{width:40%;display:block}
.lp2 .multi-post .mulpost:first-child .post-thumbnail{height:300px;display:block!important}
.lp2 .multi-post .mulpost .post-thumbnail{display:none}
#lp22 h2.title{color:#333333;font:normal 800 17px neo;line-height:25px;margin-bottom:15px;width:100%;background:#f8f8f8;padding:15px}
.lp2 .multi-post .mulpost:first-child .label-content{padding:15px;background:#333333;color:white;font-family:neo}
.lp2 .multi-post .mulpost .label-content .category{color:#8bc34a;font-family:Neo;line-height:25px}
.lp2 .multi-post .mulpost:first-child .label-content .mpost-title{margin:5px 0}
.lp2 .multi-post .mulpost:first-child .label-content .mpost-title a{color:white;font-family:Neo;font-size:17px;font-weight:500;line-height:24px}
.lp2 .mulpost .pinfo li{text-transform:capitalize;font-size:10px;color:#7f8c8d;display:inline-block;margin-left:6px;font-family:Neo,tahoma;padding-right:4px;margin-top:7px;line-height:24px}
.lp2 .mulpost .mtime{margin-left:15px}
.lp2 .mulpost .pinfo li:before{font-family:fontawesome;display:inline-block;margin-left:5px}
.lp2 .mulpost .post-author:before{content:"\f007"}
.lp2 .mulpost .mtime:before{content:"\f017"}
.lp2 .multi-post .mulpost .label-content{margin-bottom:10px}
.lp2 .multi-post .mulpost .label-content .mpost-title a{color:#333333;font-family:Neo;font-size:15px;line-height:24px}
.section:first-child .widget:first-child{margin-top:30px}
/* ====================
12:Last post 3 & 6 & 5
* ==================== */
#lp33 h2.title,#lp55 h2.title,#lp66 h2.title,#lp77 h2.title{color:#333333;font:normal 800 17px neo;line-height:25px;margin-bottom:15px;width:100%;background:#f8f8f8;padding:15px}
.lp3 .multi-post .mulpost .post-thumbnail a,.lp5 .multi-post .mulpost .post-thumbnail a,.lp6 .multi-post .mulpost .post-thumbnail a,.lp7 .multi-post .mulpost .post-thumbnail a{opacity:0.6}
.lp3 .multi-post .mulpost .post-thumbnail,.lp5 .multi-post .mulpost .post-thumbnail,.lp6 .multi-post .mulpost .post-thumbnail,.lp7 .multi-post .mulpost .post-thumbnail{height:100px;background:#000;transition:.3s;width:100px;float:right;margin:0 0 0 10px}
.lp3 .multi-post .mulpost a.category,.lp5 .multi-post .mulpost a.category,.lp6 .multi-post .mulpost a.category,.lp7 .multi-post .mulpost a.category{display:none}
.lp3 .multi-post .mulpost,.lp5 .multi-post .mulpost,.lp6 .multi-post .mulpost,.lp7 .multi-post .mulpost{margin-bottom:10px;background:#f8f8f8}
.lp3 .multi-post .mulpost h3.mpost-title a,.lp5 .multi-post .mulpost h3.mpost-title a,.lp6 .multi-post .mulpost h3.mpost-title a,.lp7 .multi-post .mulpost h3.mpost-title a{color:#333333;font-family:Neo;font-size:15px;line-height:24px}
.lp3 .mulpost .pinfo li,.lp5 .mulpost .pinfo li,.lp6 .mulpost .pinfo li,.lp7 .mulpost .pinfo li{text-transform:capitalize;font-size:10px;color:#7f8c8d;display:inline-block;margin-left:6px;font-family:Neo,tahoma;padding-right:4px;margin-top:7px;line-height:24px}
.lp3 .mulpost .mtime,.lp5 .mulpost .mtime,.lp6 .mulpost .mtime,.lp7 .mulpost .mtime{margin-left:15px}
.lp3 .mulpost .pinfo li:before,.lp5 .mulpost .pinfo li:before,.lp6 .mulpost .pinfo li:before,.lp7 .mulpost .pinfo li:before{font-family:fontawesome;display:inline-block;margin-left:5px}
.lp3 .mulpost .post-author:before,.lp5 .mulpost .post-author:before,.lp6 .mulpost .post-author:before,.lp7 .mulpost .post-author:before{content:"\f007"}
.lp3 .mulpost .mtime:before,.lp5 .mulpost .mtime:before,.lp6 .mulpost .mtime:before,.lp7 .mulpost .mtime:before{content:"\f017"}
.lp3 .mulpost .post-com,.lp5 .mulpost .post-com,.lp6 .mulpost .post-com,.lp7 .mulpost .post-com{display:none!important}
div#lp55,div#lp66,div#lp77{margin:0}
.lp3 .label-content,.lp5 .label-content,.lp6 .label-content{padding:5px}
/* ====================
13:Last post 4 & 8
* ==================== */
.blackpo{background:#333333;margin-top:30px;padding:30px 0}
.lp4 .multi-post .mulpost{border:5px solid #333333;padding:0}
.blackpo .section{margin:0}
.blackpo .section .widget:first-child{margin:0}
.lp4 .multi-post .category,.lp4 .multi-post .post-com,.lp4 .multi-post .post-author,.lp8 .multi-post .category,.lp8 .multi-post .post-com,.lp8 .multi-post .post-author{display:none}
.lp4 .multi-post .mpost-title,.lp8 .multi-post .mpost-title{padding:10px;background:#f8f8f8}
.lp4 .multi-post .mpost-title a,.lp8 .multi-post .mpost-title a{line-height:24px;color:#333333;font-family:neo;font-weight:500;font-size:16px}
.lp4 .multi-post .pinfo .mtime,.lp8 .multi-post .pinfo .mtime{position:absolute;top:0;margin:5px;padding:5px;background:#8bc34a;color:white;font-size:11px;font-family:neo}
#lp44 h2.title,#lp88 h2.title{color:#333333;font:normal 800 17px neo;line-height:25px;margin-bottom:15px;width:100%;background:#f8f8f8;padding:15px}
.lp4 .mulpost .label-content{position:absolute;bottom:0;padding:15px;text-align:center;color:#ffffff;font-family:tahoma,sans-serif;font-size:13px}
.lp8 .mulpost .label-content{bottom:0;text-align:center;padding:15px;color:#ffffff;font-family:tahoma,sans-serif;font-size:13px;position:absolute;width:100%}
.lp8 .multi-post .mpost-title{background:#f8f8f8}
/* ====================
14:Posts
* ==================== */
h2.date-header,.icon-action{display:none}
.post-share-buttons.goog-inline-block{display:none}
.blog-feeds{display:none}
.post-feeds{display:none}
div#main{margin:0}
.info{position:relative;height:200px;overflow:hidden;background:#f8f8f8;transition:all .5s ease-in-out}
.post-info{padding:0 10px 10px;width:60%;float:left}
.post-thumb img{width:40%;height:200px;transition:all .5s ease-in-out}
.boxs:before{border-right:1px solid #ffffff;border-left:1px solid #ffffff;width:38%;height:0}
.boxs:after{border-top:1px solid #ffffff;border-bottom:1px solid #ffffff;width:0;height:90%}
.boxs:before,.boxs:after{content:"";position:absolute;top:5%;right:1%;z-index:1;-webkit-transition:.3s ease-out;transition:.3s ease-out}
.post-home:hover .boxs:before,.post-home:hover .boxs:after{width:38%;height:90%}
.post-share{z-index:9;opacity:1;float:left;display:none}
.post-share a i{font-size:16px;border-radius:2px;line-height:38px;width:38px;text-align:center;height:38px;border:1px solid red;color:red}
.post-share a i.fa-facebook:hover{border:1px solid #39599f;color:#39599f}
.post-share a i.fa-twitter:hover{border:1px solid #45b0e3;color:#45b0e3}
.post-share a i.fa-google-plus:hover{border:1px solid #fa0101;color:#fa0101}
.post{margin:0;padding:0;margin-bottom:5px;overflow:hidden}
.post-home{overflow:hidden;margin:0 0 10px}
.info h2.post-title.entry-title{overflow:visible;font-size:24px;line-height:26px;text-align:right;z-index:999;padding:10px;margin:0;font-weight:normal;clear:left;width:60%;float:left}
.info h2.post-title.entry-title a{font-size:19px;color:#333333;font-family:Neo;font-weight:normal}
.info h2.post-title.entry-title a:hover{color:#8bc34a}
.post-meta{text-align:right;padding:5px 10px;background:#c1c1c1;z-index:99;float:left;width:60%;position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0}
.post-meta span.post-author.vcard,#meta-post span.post-author.vcard{display:inline-block;margin-left:5px;color:#ffffff;font-size:12px}
#meta-post span.post-author.vcard a,#meta-post span.post-timestamp a{color:#7f8c8d!important}
#meta-post span.post-author.vcard,#meta-post span.post-timestamp{color:#7f8c8d!important}
.post-meta span.post-timestamp,#meta-post span.post-timestamp{margin:0;color:#ffffff;font-size:12px}
.post-meta span.post-author.vcard a,.post-meta span.post-timestamp a,#meta-post span.post-author.vcard a,#meta-post span.post-timestamp a{font-family:Neo,sans-serif;color:#ffffff;font-size:11px}
.post-info .post-snippet{color:#555555;font-family:tahoma,sans-serif;font-size:14px;clear:both;opacity:0.8}
h3.post-title.entry-title{font-family:Neo,sans-serif;color:#333333;font-weight:normal;font-size:27px;margin-bottom:15px}
img.author-pic{display:none}
div#meta-post{width:100%}
.post-body{width:100%;overflow:hidden;font-family:tahoma,sans-serif;line-height:26px;font-size:16px;color:#555555;font-weight:400}
.item .post-body span{font-family:Neo;line-height:40px;font-size:17px!important}
.info .jump-linke a{font-family:Neo;font-size:12px;padding:15px 15px;position:absolute;bottom:0;background:#555555;left:0;color:white}
.info .jump-linke a:hover{color:#8bc34a}
.info .jump-linke a:after{content:"\f060";font-family:FontAwesome;position:relative;right:6px}
.headertitle{font-family:Neo;padding-bottom:15px;border-bottom:1px solid #e7e7e7;margin-bottom:15px;text-align:center}
/* ====================
15:Number Pages
* ==================== */
div#settings{display:none}
#blog-pager,.pagenavi{clear:both;text-align:center;margin:10px}
#blog-pager a,.pagenavi span,.pagenavi a{margin:0 5px 0 0;padding:7px 15px;text-decoration:none;color:#ffffff;background:#555555;-webkit-transition:all .3s ease-in;-moz-transition:all .3s ease-in;-o-transition:all .3s ease-in;transition:all .3s ease-in;font-family:Neo,sans-serif;display:inline-block;border-radius:5px}
#blog-pager a:hover,.pagenavi a:hover{color:#ffffff;background:#8bc34a;text-decoration:none}
#blog-pager-older-link,#blog-pager-newer-link{float:none}
.pagenavi .current{color:#ffffff;background:#8bc34a;text-decoration:none}
.pagenavi .pages{display:none}
/* ====================
16:PostShare
* ==================== */
.post-shar{margin:20px auto;overflow:hidden;position:relative;padding:15px 15px 15px 0;display:block}
.shrtitle{display:inline-block;float:right;margin-top:4px;font-family:Neo;color:#333333;font:normal 800 17px neo}
.post-shar a{height:35px;width:12%;position:relative;text-align:center;float:left;margin:0 3px;font-size:17px;line-height:35px;transition:0.3s;color:#ffffff;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px transparent}
.post-shar .share-facebook{background:#3b5998}
.post-shar .share-twitter{background:#55acee}
.post-shar .share-gplus{background:#dd4b39}
.post-shar a:hover{background:#8bc34a}
/* ====================
17:InPostNavigation
* ==================== */
.item #blog-pager{margin:0 0 20px;clear:both;text-align:initial}
.item #blog-pager a,.item .blog-pager span.linkgrey.left,.item .blog-pager span.linkgrey.right{padding:15px 0;margin:0;width:49.6%!important;text-decoration:none;line-height:30px;color:#333333;text-align:center;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;text-overflow:ellipsis;float:right;border:none;background:#f8f8f8;font-family:Neo,sans-serif;border-radius:0;margin-right:3px;display:block;transition:all .0s ease-in}
.item #blog-pager a h6{font-size:15px;padding:0}
.item #blog-pager a h5{font-size:11px;margin-top:5px;color:#7f8c8d;font-weight:500}
.item #blog-pager a:hover{background:#8bc34a;color:white}
.item #blog-pager a:hover h5{color:white}
/* ====================
18:RelatedPosts
* ==================== */
.widget-ti-re h3{padding:15px;display:block;margin-top:4px;font-family:Neo;color:#333333;font:normal 800 17px neo}
#related-posts .mulpost{position:relative;overflow:hidden;width:32%;margin-right:1%;float:right}
#related-posts .multi-post{position:relative;margin:10px 0 20px;padding:0;line-height:0}
#related-posts .mulpost .label-content a.category{padding:6px 9px;background:#8bc34a;color:#ffffff;font-family:Neo;font-size:13px;display:inline-block;z-index:1;border-radius:2px}
#related-posts .label-content{position:absolute;bottom:0;padding:10px;text-align:center;background:-moz-linear-gradient(top,rgba(0,0,0,0) 0%,rgba(0,0,0,0.5) 100%);background:-webkit-gradient(linear,left top,left bottom,color-stop(0%,rgba(0,0,0,0)),color-stop(100%,rgba(0,0,0,0.5)));background:-webkit-linear-gradient(top,rgba(0,0,0,0) 0%,rgba(0,0,0,0.5) 100%);background:-o-linear-gradient(top,rgba(0,0,0,0) 0%,rgba(0,0,0,0.5) 100%);background:-ms-linear-gradient(top,rgba(0,0,0,0) 0%,rgba(0,0,0,0.5) 100%);background:linear-gradient(to bottom,rgba(0,0,0,0) 0%,rgba(0,0,0,0.5) 100%);filter:progid:DXImageTransform.Microsoft.gradient( startColorstr='#00000000',endColorstr='#a6000000',GradientType=0 );color:#ffffff;font-family:tahoma,sans-serif;font-size:13px;width:100%}
#related-posts .post-thumbnail{height:200px;background:#000;transition:.3s}
#related-posts .mpost-title a{color:#ffffff;font-family:Neo;font-size:16px;display:block;padding-right:5px;margin:10px auto}
#related-posts .mpost-title a:hover{color:#8bc34a}
#related-posts .mulpost .pinfo li{display:none}
#related-posts .mulpost .post-thumbnail a{opacity:0.7;filter:alpha(opacity=30);-moz-filter:url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><filter id&#8230;0.3333 0 0 0.3333 0.3333 0.3333 0 0 0 0 0 1 0'/></filter></svg>#grayscale");-o-filter:url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><filter id&#8230;0.3333 0 0 0.3333 0.3333 0.3333 0 0 0 0 0 1 0'/></filter></svg>#grayscale");filter:gray}
/* ====================
19:Comments
* ==================== */
div#comments{margin:0}
div#comments h4{padding:15px;display:block;margin-top:4px;font-family:Neo;color:#333333;font:normal 800 17px neo}
div#comments h4:before{content:"\f086";font-family:fontawesome;font-size:16px;color:#8bc34a;padding-left:5px}
div#comments .comment{padding:5px}
div#comments .comment .comment-header{padding:5px 0;margin:0}
.comments-content{padding:0 5px}
.comments .avatar-image-container{float:right;max-height:36px;overflow:hidden;width:36px;position:relative;z-index:999}
.comments .comment-block{position:relative;outline:1px solid #e7e7e7;padding:10px;overflow:hidden;background:#ffffff}
cite.user{float:right;margin-right:18px;margin-top:-5px}
cite.user a{color:#8bc34a;font-family:Neo,sans-serif;font-size:15px}
span.datetime.secondary-text{float:left;margin-right:18px!important;margin-top:-5px}
span.datetime.secondary-text a:before{content:"\f017";font-family:fontawesome;font-size:16px;color:#8bc34a;position:absolute;right:0}
span.datetime.secondary-text a{color:#555555;font-family:Neo,sans-serif;font-size:15px;position:relative;padding-right:20px}
.comments-content .comment-content{clear:both;font-family:Neo,sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;padding:15px 5px;line-height:27px;margin:0!important;color:#7f8c8d}
.comment-actions a,.thread-count a,.continue a{font-family:tahoma;color:#555555}
/* ====================
18:SocialMedia
* ==================== */
#side-social .widget{margin:0!important}
#side-social{padding:20px;background:#ffffff;border:1px solid #e7e7e7}
.sidebar .social h2{display:none}
.sidebar .social .social-widget ul li{float:right;width:48.3333%;padding:20px;background:#ffffff;margin:1px;border:1px solid #e7e7e7;transition:.0s}
.sidebar .social .social-widget ul li.facebook{background:#39599f}
.sidebar .social .social-widget ul li.youtube{background:#cc181e}
.sidebar .social .social-widget ul li.twitter{background:#45b0e3}
.sidebar .social .social-widget ul li.google-plus{background:#fa0101}
.sidebar .social .social-widget ul li.instagram{background:#3f729b}
.sidebar .social .social-widget ul li.rss{background:#f26522}
.sidebar .social .social-widget ul li i{display:block;text-align:center;color:#ffffff;margin-bottom:5px;font-size:27px}
.sidebar .social .social-widget ul li span.count{display:block;text-align:center;color:#ffffff;font-size:16px;font-family:Neo;margin-bottom:5px}
.sidebar .social .social-widget ul li span.social-text{display:block;text-align:center;color:#ffffff;font-size:16px;font-family:tahoma}
.sidebar .social .social-widget ul li:hover{background:#8bc34a}
/* ====================
19:Sidebar
* ==================== */
#sidebar-wrapper .section{margin:0}
#sidebar .widget{background:#ffffff;font-family:tahoma,sans-serif;font-size:13px;margin:15px 0;padding:0}
#sidebar h2{padding:0 0 0 10px;font-weight:normal;font-family:Neo;color:#8bc34a;font-size:19px;float:right;background:white;margin-bottom:-10px}
#sidebar .widget-content,#sidebar .contact-form-widget,#sidebar .post-summary{padding:20px;clear:both;border:1px solid #e7e7e7}
div#sidebar a{color:#555555;font-family:Neo;font-size:14px;line-height:26px}
div#sidebar a:hover{text-decoration:none;color:#8bc34a}
#sidebar .widget ul{padding:0;margin:10px 0}
/* ====================
20:BlogArchive
* ==================== */
.BlogArchive #ArchiveList ul.posts li{padding-right:1.3em;line-height:0}
.BlogArchive #ArchiveList ul.posts li a{line-height:18px;font-size:14px;font-family:tahoma}
li.archivedate{list-style:circle inside!important}
#ArchiveList select{width:100%;margin:0;height:40px;border-color:#e7e7e7;font-family:Neo,sans-serif}
.BlogArchive #ArchiveList ul li{background:none;list-style:none!important;list-style-image:none!important;list-style-position:outside!important;border-width:0;padding-right:15px;text-indent:-15px;margin:.25em 0;background-image:none}
.archivedate .toggle{color:#9d3393!important}
.archivedate span.post-count{color:#9d3393!important}
/* ====================
21:Labels I
* ==================== */
.Label ul li{background:#555555;color:#ffffff;display:inline-block;font-size:15px;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:3px;margin-bottom:4px}
.Label ul li a{color:#ffffff!important}
.Label ul li:hover a{color:#ffffff!important;text-decoration:none!important}
.Label ul li:hover span{color:#ffffff!important}
.Label ul li span{font-family:tahoma,sans-serif;position:relative;padding:8px;left:-4px;transition:.4s;font-weight:normal;color:#ffffff}
.Label ul{margin:0!important}
.Label ul li:nth-child(1):hover{background:#f05555}
.Label ul li:nth-child(2):hover{background:#00afd8}
.Label ul li:nth-child(3):hover{background:#f9ae00}
.Label ul li:nth-child(4):hover{background:#e1702c}
.Label ul li:nth-child(5):hover{background:#9b59b6}
.Label ul li:nth-child(6):hover{background:#37cae8}
.Label ul li:nth-child(7):hover{background:#3f51b5}
.Label ul li:nth-child(8):hover{background:#8bc34a}
.Label ul li:nth-child(9):hover{background:#3f729b}
.Label ul li:nth-child(10):hover{background:#fe7a15}
/* ====================
22:Follow Email
* ==================== */
.sidebar input.follow-by-email-submit{border:1px solid #eee!important;background:#ffffff!important;font-family:sans-serif!important;height:39px!important;width:99%!important;color:#161616!important;cursor:pointer!important;margin-right:2px!important;border-radius:0!important;transition:0.6s ease;position:relative}
.sidebar input.follow-by-email-submit:hover{border-color:#ff9900!important;color:#ff9900!important}
.sidebar input.follow-by-email-address{width:100%!important;border:1px solid #e7e7e7!important;font-family:tahoma!important;text-indent:10px!important;height:37px!important}
.sidebar input.follow-by-email-address:focus{border:1px solid #ff9900!important}
/* ====================
23:Contact Form
* ==================== */
.contact-form-widget{max-width:99%;padding:0;text-align:center;margin:0}
.ContactForm > div.contact-form-widget > div > form > span{color:#555555}
.ContactForm > div.contact-form-widget > div > form{font:14px Neo;color:#555555;text-align:right}
.contact-form-name,.contact-form-email,.contact-form-email-message{width:100%!important;max-width:280px;color:#555555;font:15px tahoma,sans-serif;padding:20px;margin:5px 0;transition:.0s ease;border:1px solid #e7e7e7}
.contact-form-email:focus,.contact-form-name:focus,.contact-form-email-message:focus{border:1px solid #8bc34a;outline:none;box-shadow:none}
.contact-form-email:hover,.contact-form-name:hover,.contact-form-email-message:hover{border:1px solid #8bc34a;outline:none;box-shadow:none}
.contact-form-button-submit:hover{border:1px solid #8bc34a;color:#ffffff;background:#8bc34a;cursor:pointer}
.contact-form-button-submit{width:100%;height:50px;font:15px Neo;background-image:none;background:#ffffff;color:#555555;border-radius:0;border:1px solid #e7e7e7;transition:.0s ease}
.contact-form-button-submit:focus{border:1px solid #8bc34a}
/* ====================
24:TextBox
* ==================== */
.Text .widget-content{font-family:tahoma,sans-serif;font-size:15px;color:#555555;line-height:20px;text-align:right!important}
/* ====================
25:Labels II
* ==================== */
.label-size{line-height:1.2;font-size:14px;color:#555555;opacity:1;display:block;transition:.0s;position:relative;padding:6px;outline:1px solid #e7e7e7;margin:0 0 8px}
.label-size span.label-count{float:left;position:relative;top:4px}
.label-size:hover{color:#ffffff;background:#8bc34a;outline:1px solid #8bc34a}
.label-size:hover a{color:#ffffff!important}
.label-size a:hover{text-decoration:none!important}
/* ====================
26:Popular Posts
* ==================== */
.PopularPosts .item-thumbnail{float:left;margin:5px 0 0}
.PopularPosts ul{margin:0!important}
.PopularPosts .widget-content ul li{overflow:hidden;margin:0!important}
.PopularPosts .item-thumbnail{width:80px;height:80px;overflow:hidden;float:right;margin-left:15px;background:#8bc34a;border-radius:3px}
.PopularPosts ul li:hover .item-title a{color:#8bc34a!important}
.PopularPosts img{height:80px;margin-left:15px;width:80px;padding:0;transform:scale(1.4)}
.PopularPosts .widget-content ul li:hover img{opacity:0.7}
.PopularPosts img:hover{opacity:0.7}
.item-snippet{displayl:none;font-family:tahoma,sans-serif;font-size:11px;line-height:1.5em;font-weight:normal;color:#666;display:none}
.item-title a{font-family:Neo;color:#555555;display:block;margin-bottom:5.5px}
/* ====================
27:Featured Post
* ==================== */
.FeaturedPost .post-summary{padding:10px!important}
.FeaturedPost .post-summary h3{padding:5px}
.FeaturedPost .post-summary h3 a{font-size:16px!important}
.FeaturedPost .post-summary p{padding:5px;font-family:tahoma,sans-serif;color:#8c8b8b}
.FeaturedPost .post-summary img{padding:5px}
/* ====================
28:Status Msg
* ==================== */
.status-msg-border{border:1px solid #8c8b8b;filter:alpha(opacity=1);-moz-opacity:1;opacity:1;width:100%;position:relative}
.status-msg-bg{background-color:#ffffff;opacity:1;filter:alpha(opacity=1);-moz-opacity:1;width:100%;position:relative;z-index:1}
.status-msg-hidden{visibility:hidden;padding:15px 0}
.status-msg-body{text-align:center;padding:15px 0;width:100%;position:absolute;font-family:Neo;z-index:4}
.status-msg-body b{font-weight:normal;color:#8c8b8b;padding-left:5px}
.status-msg-wrap a{padding-right:.4em;text-decoration:underline;color:#8c8b8b;font-family:Neo}
/* ====================
29:CopyRight - CopyLeft xD
* ==================== */
div#copyright{width:100%;padding:10px 0;clear:both;background:#555555}
#copyright .right_c,#copyright .left_c{text-align:center;font-family:Neo;font-size:13px;color:#ffffff;line-height:24px}
#copyright .right_c a,#copyright .left_c a{text-align:center;font-family:Neo;font-size:13px;color:#8bc34a}
/*----owlcarosel----*/
.owl-carousel .animated{-webkit-animation-duration:1000ms;animation-duration:1000ms;-webkit-animation-fill-mode:both;animation-fill-mode:both}
.owl-carousel .owl-animated-in{z-index:0}
.owl-carousel .owl-animated-out{z-index:1}
.owl-carousel .fadeOut{-webkit-animation-name:fadeOut;animation-name:fadeOut}
@-webkit-keyframes fadeOut{0%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0}}
@keyframes fadeOut{0%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0}}
.owl-height{-webkit-transition:height 500ms ease-in-out;-moz-transition:height 500ms ease-in-out;-ms-transition:height 500ms ease-in-out;-o-transition:height 500ms ease-in-out;transition:height 500ms ease-in-out}
.owl-carousel{display:none;width:100%;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;position:relative;z-index:1}
.owl-carousel .owl-stage{position:relative;-ms-touch-action:pan-Y}
.owl-carousel .owl-stage:after{content:&quot;.&quot;;display:block;clear:both;visibility:hidden;line-height:0;height:0}
.owl-carousel .owl-stage-outer{position:relative;overflow:hidden;-webkit-transform:translate3d(0,0,0)}
.owl-carousel .owl-controls .owl-dot,.owl-carousel .owl-controls .owl-nav .owl-next,.owl-carousel .owl-controls .owl-nav .owl-prev{cursor:pointer;cursor:hand;-webkit-user-select:none;-khtml-user-select:none;-moz-user-select:none;-ms-user-select:none;user-select:none}
.owl-carousel.owl-loaded{display:block}
.owl-carousel.owl-loading{opacity:0;display:block}
.owl-carousel.owl-hidden{opacity:0}
.owl-carousel .owl-refresh .owl-item{display:none}
.owl-carousel .owl-item{position:relative;min-height:1px;float:left;-webkit-backface-visibility:hidden;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;-webkit-touch-callout:none;-webkit-user-select:none;-moz-user-select:none;-ms-user-select:none;user-select:none}
.owl-carousel .owl-item img{display:block;width:100%;-webkit-transform-style:preserve-3d}
.owl-carousel.owl-text-select-on .owl-item{-webkit-user-select:auto;-moz-user-select:auto;-ms-user-select:auto;user-select:auto}
.owl-carousel .owl-grab{cursor:move;cursor:-webkit-grab;cursor:-o-grab;cursor:-ms-grab;cursor:grab}
.owl-carousel.owl-rtl{direction:rtl}
.owl-carousel.owl-rtl .owl-item{float:right}
.no-js .owl-carousel{display:block}
.owl-carousel .owl-item .owl-lazy{opacity:0;-webkit-transition:opacity 400ms ease;-moz-transition:opacity 400ms ease;-ms-transition:opacity 400ms ease;-o-transition:opacity 400ms ease;transition:opacity 400ms ease}
.owl-carousel .owl-item img{transform-style:preserve-3d}
.owl-carousel .owl-video-wrapper{position:relative;height:100%;background:#000}
.owl-carousel .owl-video-play-icon{position:absolute;height:80px;width:80px;left:50%;top:50%;margin-left:-40px;margin-top:-40px;background:url(owl.video.play.png) no-repeat;cursor:pointer;z-index:1;-webkit-backface-visibility:hidden;-webkit-transition:scale 100ms ease;-moz-transition:scale 100ms ease;-ms-transition:scale 100ms ease;-o-transition:scale 100ms ease;transition:scale 100ms ease}
.owl-carousel .owl-video-play-icon:hover{-webkit-transition:scale(1.3,1.3);-moz-transition:scale(1.3,1.3);-ms-transition:scale(1.3,1.3);-o-transition:scale(1.3,1.3);transition:scale(1.3,1.3)}
.owl-carousel .owl-video-playing .owl-video-play-icon,.owl-carousel .owl-video-playing .owl-video-tn{display:none}
.owl-carousel .owl-video-tn{opacity:0;height:100%;background-position:center center;background-repeat:no-repeat;-webkit-background-size:contain;-moz-background-size:contain;-o-background-size:contain;background-size:contain;-webkit-transition:opacity 400ms ease;-moz-transition:opacity 400ms ease;-ms-transition:opacity 400ms ease;-o-transition:opacity 400ms ease;transition:opacity 400ms ease}
.owl-carousel .owl-video-frame{position:relative;z-index:1}
.owl-theme .owl-controls{margin-top:10px;text-align:center;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
.owl-theme .owl-controls .owl-nav [class*=owl-]{color:#ffffff;font-size:14px;margin:5px;padding:4px 7px;background:#d6d6d6;display:inline-block;cursor:pointer;-webkit-border-radius:3px;-moz-border-radius:3px;border-radius:3px}
.owl-theme .owl-controls .owl-nav [class*=owl-]:hover{background:#869791;color:#ffffff;text-decoration:none}
.owl-theme .owl-controls .owl-nav .disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:default}
.owl-theme .owl-dots .owl-dot{display:inline-block;zoom:1;*display:inline}
.owl-theme .owl-dots .owl-dot span{width:10px;height:10px;margin:5px 7px;background:#d6d6d6;display:block;-webkit-backface-visibility:visible;-webkit-transition:opacity 200ms ease;-moz-transition:opacity 200ms ease;-ms-transition:opacity 200ms ease;-o-transition:opacity 200ms ease;transition:opacity 200ms ease;-webkit-border-radius:30px;-moz-border-radius:30px;border-radius:30px}
.owl-theme .owl-dots .owl-dot.active span,.owl-theme .owl-dots .owl-dot:hover span{background:#869791}
/*--------------*/
.widget li,.BlogArchive #ArchiveList ul.flat li,.widget ul{padding:0}
.post-thumbnail a{display:block;opacity:1;z-index:999}
.ocrsel .post-thumbnail{height:200px;background:#000;transition:.3s}
.ocraousel .post-thumbnail{height:500px;background:#000;transition:.3s}
.ocraousel .post-thumbnail a{opacity:0.4}
.widget,.widget-content,.multi-post,.mulpost,.post-thumbnail a{height:100%;display:block;overflow:hidden}
div#settings{display:none}
/*----boxsizing----*/
*{box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-box-sizing:border-box;-mz-box-sizing:border-box;-o-box-sizing:border-box;word-wrap:normal!important;overflow-wrap:normal!important;word-break:normal!important}
/*---respansive---*/
@media screen and (max-width:1143px){
.pager-isi a,.pager-isi .linkgrey{width:100%!important;margin-bottom:5px!important;margin-right:0!important}
}
@media screen and (max-width:992px){
.menu-container{background:transparent;padding:5px}
#related-posts .mulpost{width:100%;margin-bottom:5px;float:right}
#nav,#nav1{display:none}
.selectnav{display:block;margin:3px 0;padding:3px;width:100%;height:35px;font-size:15px;font-family:Neo;color:#ffffff;border:0 solid;background:#8bc34a}
div#logoads img{margin:0 auto;padding:10px;width:200px;height:200px}
#logoo{text-align:center;float:none;margin:0 auto}
#main-wrapper{width:100%}
span.datetime.secondary-text{display:none}
.pager-isi a,.pager-isi .linkgrey{width:100%!important;margin-bottom:5px!important;margin-right:0!important}
.ContactForm > div.contact-form-widget > div > form{text-align:center}
}

<style id="template-skin-1" type="text/css"><!--
body#layout{background-color:$(white.color);border:none;padding:19px 0 0}
#layout:before{content:"عدد_التدوينات_في_صفحة_واحدة";background:#ff9900!important;margin-top:30px;margin-bottom:18px!important;position:relative;z-index:9999;font-family:tahoma;width:34%;display:block;padding:18px;font-size:20px;color:white;margin:0 auto}
#layout #header-wrapper:before{content:"التخطيط";background:#ff9900!important;margin-top:30px;margin-bottom:18px!important;position:relative;z-index:9999;font-family:tahoma;width:25%;display:block;padding:18px;font-size:20px;color:white;margin:0 auto}
body#layout #menu-top{width:50%;float:left}
body#layout #logoo{width:50%;float:left}
body#layout #ads{width:30%}
body#layout div#lp22{float:right;width:40%}
body#layout div#lp33{width:40%;float:left}
body#layout div#lp55,body#layout div#lp66,body#layout div#lp77{float:right;width:28%}
body#layout #top-social{width:30%}
body#layout .footer-columen{width:50%;float:right}
body#layout .sub-menu-s .sub-s{width:25%;float:right;padding:0}
body#layout .sub-menu-s{position:static;overflow:hidden;max-width:initial;width:initial;padding:0}
body#layout .header-inner-wrapper .header{display:none}
body#layout div.menu li .widget-content{display:none}
body#layout div#partner_pic{clear:both}
body#layout #main-wrapper{overflow:visible;width:70%;float:right}
body#layout #sidebar-wrapper{overflow:visible;width:25%;float:left}
body#layout .section h4{margin:2px;font-family:tahoma;text-transform:uppercase}
body#layout div.layout-title{height:1.4em;line-height:1.4em;overflow:hidden;font-family:tahoma}
